annotations.title: Configure or update the branding of an exam with an image (used as a logo or as a cover) and a color

description: Configure or update the branding of an exam with an image (used as a logo or as a cover) and a color.

image.description: branding image, a URL, base64-encoded data (optionally as a data URL), or the identifier of an image uploaded to the filebin, supported formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP

type.description: branding image type (foreground: image is used as a logo, background: image is used as a cover), default: foreground

name: edubase_post_exam_branding
